name: Combat
kicker:
Fights, finishing moves and boss battles
Heavy weapons: X / A / B block left, centre, right
Dual blades: X / A / B dodge left, centre, right

left.title: Super
left.sub: Fire your super when the meter is full

left.title: Click
left.sub: Tap the screen where the cursor is

left.title: Slash
left.sub: Flick in any of 12 directions; swing to a new one to chain

center.title: Cursor and click
center.sub: Right stick moves the cursor; R3 clicks

name: Exploring
kicker:
Walking the world, picking paths, chests and pickups
The left stick never opens or moves any menu while you explore

left.title: Click
left.sub: Hold and move the right stick to drag

left.title: Swipe the view
left.sub: Quick camera turn, like a touch swipe

right.title: Tap
right.sub: Click where the cursor is: paths, chests, people

combos.title: Drag
combos.sub: Hold LB and move the right stick

combos.title: Reward popups
combos.sub: Keep the plain controls; A taps, Y confirms

center.title: Look around
center.sub: Moves the camera like a mouse

center.title: Recentre camera
center.sub: Press the right stick; the view glides back

name: Menus
kicker:
Hub, Items, Gem Bag, Supplies, Skills, Goals, Customize, Blacksmith, Cauldron, Fusion
A gold outline shows what A will press

left.title: Items list
left.sub: On Items and the Gem Bag

left.title: Move the outline
left.sub: Same as the D-pad on menu screens

right.title: Screen action
right.sub: Buy, sell, accept, cook, fuse, gear menu

right.title: Snap
right.sub: Jump the outline to the nearest button

right.title: Back
right.sub: One layer back, via the screen's own arrow

combos.title: Drag-scroll
combos.sub: Hold LB and move the right stick

combos.title: Lost the outline?
combos.sub: X puts it back on the nearest button

combos.title: Popups open on No
combos.sub: A stray press never spends anything

center.title: Move the outline
center.sub: Starts at the button under the cursor; hold to repeat; scrolls lists

center.title: Free cursor
center.sub: R3 is a click you can hold, e.g. to turn the model
